name: fux-agent-exercises
description: Opt-in pi-driven exercises that measure how well an agent can operate fux through its BRP API.
comment: No dependencies on purpose: the pi SDK and typebox are imported from the globally installed @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent through one resolved package root, so only one typebox instance exists. Node >=23.6 runs the TypeScript sources directly by stripping types; there is no build step and no typecheck.
